description: Human verdicts the generator cannot derive from code, keyed by CloudFormation type name. verdict is cascade (retiring this type should retire the listed children) or no-cascade. status is proposed-unverified until a live trial shows the behaviour, then verified. Rule (ruled by George in conversation, 2026-11-01): a child cascades when it cannot exist without its parent (identity scoped under it, or its API requires it); not when it is only attached to or referenced by the parent, or may outlive it. A type with no entry reads as undecided. Delete none without saying why in the commit.
